metrics.BA: balanced accuracy over the two MI classes
metrics.protected_branch_erasure_harm_BA: BA(full logits) - BA(logits with protected contribution removed)
metrics.adaptive_branch_erasure_harm_BA: BA(full logits) - BA(logits with adaptive contribution removed)
metrics.D_finite: RMS centered-logit change caused by erasure
metrics.functional_teacher_correlation: Pearson correlation between learned branch and frozen teacher target centered logits
metrics.PUD_minus_Vanilla: future-session subject BA(PUD source-only) - BA(frozen B0 replay)
metrics.PUD_minus_Dual: future-session subject BA(PUD source-only) - BA(dual task-only)
metrics.adaptation_gain: future-session subject BA(PUD adapted) - BA(PUD source-only)

statistics.seed_aggregation: average three frozen/training seeds within subject before subject-level inference
statistics.correlation_ci: separate nonparametric subject-bootstrap intervals for Pearson and Spearman

association_labels.SUPPORTED_POSITIVE_ASSOCIATION: Pearson and Spearman are positive and both 95% bootstrap lower bounds exceed zero
association_labels.SUPPORTED_NEGATIVE_ASSOCIATION: Pearson and Spearman are negative and both 95% bootstrap upper bounds are below zero
association_labels.DIRECTIONAL_BUT_UNCERTAIN: Pearson and Spearman have the same nonzero sign but at least one interval includes zero
association_labels.NO_RELIABLE_ASSOCIATION_ESTABLISHED: point-estimate signs disagree, either estimate is zero/non-finite, or fewer than three independent subjects are available

hierarchical_bootstrap.conservative_note: Only five outer folds exist; fold signs and run-level estimates are mandatory.

H3_bottleneck_gate.B1: mean paired subject delta R_P(PUD)-R_P(Dual)>0 and CI95 lower>0
H3_bottleneck_gate.B2: PUD protected erasure harm exceeds Dual, Random, and Identity; PUD-Dual CI95 lower>0
H3_bottleneck_gate.B3_STRONG: Spearman(R_P(PUD), PUD-minus-Vanilla)<0 and subject-bootstrap CI95 upper<0
H3_bottleneck_gate.B3_PARTIAL: Spearman point estimate<0 but CI includes zero
H3_bottleneck_gate.H3_STRONG: B1 support AND B2 support AND B3 strong
H3_bottleneck_gate.H3_CONCENTRATION_ONLY: B1 and B2 support but B3 is uncertain
H3_bottleneck_gate.H3_NO_HARM_LINK: B3 not support; concentration must not be claimed to explain generalization loss

certificate_transfer.consequence_question: whether the same source-certified directions remain consequential on future Session 2 on average
certificate_transfer.score_question: whether source U/D/P scores predict the magnitude or ordering of future consequence

consequence_labels.DIRECTION_CONSEQUENCE_TRANSFER_SUPPORTED: hierarchical CI lower bounds exceed zero for both future BA erasure harm and future CE erasure harm
consequence_labels.DIRECTION_CONSEQUENCE_TRANSFER_WEAK: both point estimates are positive but at least one hierarchical CI includes zero

score_labels.CERTIFICATE_SCORE_TRANSFER_POSITIVE: all three mappings have positive Pearson and Spearman estimates and all hierarchical CI lower bounds exceed zero
score_labels.CERTIFICATE_SCORE_TRANSFER_NEGATIVE: all three mappings have negative Pearson and Spearman estimates and all hierarchical CI upper bounds are below zero
score_labels.CERTIFICATE_SCORE_TRANSFER_UNCERTAIN: all three mappings have the same signed direction but at least one interval includes zero
score_labels.CERTIFICATE_SCORE_TRANSFER_NOT_ESTABLISH: mapping signs disagree, estimates are non-finite, or neither common positive nor common negative ordering is established

phase_b.architecture: single-path EEGNet F8/F16 embedding64 dropout0.25 task network plus training-only linear two-logit auxiliary head
phase_b.selection_metric: inner-validation mean subject BA from task head only
phase_b.selection_tie_break: higher BA, then smaller lambda, then earlier best epoch
phase_b.inner_teacher_training: inner_train subjects only; fixed 40 epochs; no inner-validation checkpoint selection
phase_b.outer_teacher_training: all outer-source subjects; fixed 40 epochs after lambda selection
phase_b.exact_matching: within fold/seed/stage all methods and lambdas share the same initialized complete AuxNet state, main-state SHA, minibatch seed/order, source rows, optimizer, normalization, task CE, and validation rule
phase_b.strict_nested_selection: inner teacher/certificate/identity/P/PUD/full-KD/random targets use inner_train only; inner_validation is task evaluation only; outer teacher/certificate/targets are rebuilt from all outer-source subjects after selection
phase_b.random_target: deterministic Gaussian logits centered over class first, then RMS matched to PUD functional target on the same legal source subset

success_gate.clean_constructive_extra: PUD-Aux minus historical Vanilla >=0.005 BA with paired 40-subject bootstrap CI lower>0, using the frozen B0 replay only as an external historical reference

holdout_policy.restricted_loader_guard: fail hard if any observed subject is outside the exact 40-subject pool or any WBCIC/holdout flag is true

prohibitions: no architecture or PUD definition changes
no threshold changes after outcome inspection
no PUD V2/V3 or new constructive family
